gen-fs-erode-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Erode keeps its strokes lightly modulated, with no harsh thin spots. That crispness earns its keep big and short, while Be Vietnam Pro draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin.
gen-fs-erode-general-sans: Erode shifts only mildly between heavy and light strokes, so its crisp letters feel like close relatives and keep a prominent x-height. General Sans then reads smoothly, its steady pen pressure carrying you along.
gen-fs-erode-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code leaves wide gaps between neighbors and keeps a wire-like monoline skeleton, while Erode thins only moderately, like soft-metal type. Cascadia Code makes extended reading a plain, shade-free walk, since no calligraphic shading guides the eye.
gen-fs-erode-montserrat: Erode brings crisp, graceful strokes with a mellow swing from heavy to light. Montserrat takes over with oversized counters and bent-paperclip strokes, so the page moves from tailored detail into open, friendly space.
gen-fs-erode-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab is a structured slab-serif that lets the middle zone of each line dominate. But what stands out is the shared crispness: Erode's letterpress-slug variation meets Roboto Slab's low contrast.
gen-fs-excon-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads lively, with bowls left open on one side and lowercase standing tall against capitals. And Excon, crowded like chalk marks on a full slate, is the denser partner with uniformly thick round letters.
gen-fs-excon-fs-fira-sans: Fira Sans reads with s curves that open wide at both ends and a larger-than-usual x-height. Excon shares that build, so a full page of Fira Sans keeps its flat, unshaded rhythm from top to bottom.
gen-fs-excon-fs-karma: Excon packs its letters tightly, like chalk marks on a full slate, with a single stroke weight throughout. Karma finishes its terminals away from the stem and tapers like a sharpened carpenter's pencil line.
gen-fs-excon-fs-ranade: Ranade sets its stroke ends far apart and its type widely spaced. Over a full page that gentle shift in weight feels organic, a softer partner for Excon, whose every stroke ends at a measured thickness.
gen-fs-excon-gf-lisu-bosa: Lisu Bosa lets its counters spill into the surrounding space. Excon, bent from a single wire, would feel cramped if made small, while Lisu Bosa keeps a mellow shift in weight.
